blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A network is a group of devices that can talk to each other. Laptops, phones, printers and servers can all be part of a network. At work, most people connect through Wi-Fi.

When people work from home, many use a VPN. A VPN is a secure, private tunnel. It makes your laptop act as if it were still inside the office. Another useful word is latency — the small delay between sending a message and getting an answer. Low latency feels instant. High latency makes video calls freeze and websites feel slow.

Good networks are almost invisible. You do not think about them. The moment you start thinking about the network, something is usually wrong.

items.q: What is a network?
options: A group of devices that can talk to each other
items.why: "A network is a group of devices that can talk to each other."

items.q: What does a VPN do?
options: It makes your laptop act as if it were inside the office
items.why: "A VPN… makes your laptop act as if it were still inside the office."

items.q: What happens when latency is high?
options: Video calls freeze and websites feel slow
items.why: "High latency makes video calls freeze and websites feel slow."

items.q: The text suggests that a GOOD network is one that…
items.why: Inferência: "Good networks are almost invisible" — se está tudo bem, você nem repara nele.

items.q: If you START thinking about your network, the text suggests that…
options: you should buy a new laptop
items.why: Inferência: "The moment you start thinking about the network, something is usually wrong."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily ajudando uma nova colega remota a configurar a VPN. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! Today I will help you set up your VPN, so your laptop works as if you were here in the office.

First, connect your laptop to your home Wi-Fi. Is the Wi-Fi on? Good. Now open the VPN app and type your name and password. When it says "connected", you are inside our private tunnel. This tunnel keeps your work safe.

You may notice a small delay sometimes. That delay is called latency. It is normal. If a video call starts to freeze, do not worry — just wait a few seconds, and it usually comes back.

One tip: if your internet feels slow, move closer to your Wi-Fi router. A weak signal makes everything slow. When the network works well, you will not even think about it. That is a good sign. If you have any problem, send me a message and I will help you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Emily helping her new colleague do?
items.why: "Today I will help you set up your VPN."

items.q: What must the colleague do FIRST?
options: Connect the laptop to the home Wi-Fi
items.why: "First, connect your laptop to your home Wi-Fi."

items.q: What does Emily say about the small delay?
options: It is normal and it is called latency
It means the VPN is broken
items.why: "You may notice a small delay… That delay is called latency. It is normal."

items.q: If the internet feels slow, Emily suggests that you…
options: move closer to the Wi-Fi router
items.why: Inferência: "if your internet feels slow, move closer to your Wi-Fi router. A weak signal makes everything slow."

items.q: How would you describe Emily's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas, explica com calma e oferece ajuda — um tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My phone, my laptop and the printer are all on the same network." A network is…
options: a group of devices connected together
items.why: Network = rede: dispositivos conectados que trocam dados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When I work from home, I use a ___ to connect safely to the office."
items.why: VPN = túnel seguro para trabalhar de casa como se estivesse no escritório.

items.q: "The video call started to freeze." To freeze here means…
options: to stop moving for a moment
items.why: To freeze = travar; a imagem para por alguns segundos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Low ___ feels instant, but high ___ makes websites feel slow."
items.why: Latency = latência: o atraso entre enviar e receber.

items.q: "A good network is almost invisible." Invisible means…
options: you cannot see it or notice it
items.why: Invisible = invisível: você nem percebe que está lá.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs comuns no trabalho com tecnologia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please set up the VPN on your new laptop." To set up means to…
options: prepare something so it is ready to use
items.why: Set up = configurar, deixar pronto para usar.

items.q: "I can't log in to the system." To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com usuário e senha.

items.q: "The Wi-Fi went down, so I had to reconnect." If the Wi-Fi 'went down', it…
items.why: Go down = cair, parar de funcionar (rede, sistema, site).

items.q: "Can you turn off the router and turn it on again?" To turn off means to…
items.why: Turn off = desligar; o clássico "desligar e ligar de novo".

items.q: "If you have a problem, just reach out to me." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = procurar alguém, pedir ajuda ou contato.
